headlines.title: Disney Just Made a 52-Week High While Netflix Is Down 36.2% This Year. Here’s the Better Buy Now.
headlines.summary: Disney and Netflix both have bargain-bin valuations and could pay off for long-term investors.

headlines.title: Avantis U.S. Large Cap Value ETF (AVLV) Buys $42 Million More Micron on Nov. 19
headlines.summary: The fund bought $42.0 million of Micron Technology and $16.2 million of Netflix, with $245.4 million in gross trading against $21.70 billion in assets.

headlines.title: ETFs Are Net Sellers of Netflix (NFLX) on Nov. 19
headlines.summary: ETFs sold $147.0 million of Netflix stock on Thursday, with 16 funds selling and 40 buying.

headlines.title: NFLX Vs DIS: Which Streaming Stock Is A Favorite Among Analysts?
headlines.summary: Phillip Securities downgraded Disney’s stock over the weekend, while Morningstar released a fresh take on Netflix, maintaining its $80 price target.

headlines.title: Why Did NVDA, NFLX, ORCL Slip To 52-Week Lows Last Week?
headlines.summary: Nvidia, Netflix and Oracle shares plunged to annual lows on Friday amid leadership concerns, slowing pace of growth, and broader liquidity issues following Anthropic’s recent IPO.

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
